project_info.color_palette: Teal, chili red, lime green, tortilla gold, warm market orange, cream

main_subject.detail: Three crisp folded tacos float across the center of a warm blurred street-market scene, stuffed with seasoned meats, salsa, onions, herbs, jalapeno, corn, lime, and guacamole.
main_subject.style: Ultra-real viral food photography with exuberant floating toppings and translucent recipe panels

composition_elements.text: INFOGRAPHIC; CRISPY STREET TACOS; INGREDIENTS; Corn Tortillas; Seasoned Meat; Fresh Salsa; Avocado & Guacamole; Herbs & Toppings; STEPS; 1. COOK MEAT; 2. PREP TOPPINGS; 3. ASSEMBLE TACOS; 4. ENJOY!; @StreetTacoVibes #CrispyTacos
items: Top: compact INFOGRAPHIC kicker and huge teal/red/yellow outlined title.
Center: three angled flying tacos with suspended lime, cilantro, onion, jalapeno, salsa, and cheese fragments.
Left: dark translucent ingredients panel with white icons and labels.
Right: matching translucent four-step panel with cooking icons and vertical arrows.
Background: warm shallow-focus market street with colorful banners; bottom handle and hashtag.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Warm street-market light with studio food key
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Highly saturated fresh food, glowing bokeh, crisp tortilla texture, energetic frozen-motion toppings

technical_specs.render_style: Photorealistic food poster plus vector infographic overlay

assets.name: crispy street taco food styling
assets.usage: Keep taco shell, fillings, and controlled floating garnish accurate.

assets.name: street-market backdrop
assets.usage: Provide bokeh only; no identifiable storefront or signage unless licensed.

assets.name: ingredient and steps panels
assets.usage: Maintain balanced left/right frosted-panel system and title hierarchy.

prompt_instructions: Attach food reference for exact taco style.
Keep central tacos and ingredients orbiting; avoid cluttering panels.
Use a layout tool for all recipe copy and social handle.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-viral recipe infographic. Showcase CRISPY STREET TACOS filled with seasoned meat, fresh salsa, lettuce, and creamy guacamole, angled and floating for impact. Ingredients Section: Icons for tortillas, meat, salsa, avocado, herbs. Steps Section: Arrows with pan, chop, assemble icons. Visual Style: Vibrant Mexican palette, ultra-realistic textures. Composition: Tacos front and center, ingredients orbiting. Output: 1080×1080 or 1080×1350.
prompt.negative_prompt: soggy tacos, incorrect filling, overcrowded toppings, unreadable panels, flat colors, low resolution, watermark, signature
